description: Agent Datasets: submit a dataset’s license and usage rights with the intended use: the license with its name, SPDX id (such as CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0 or ODbL-1.0), its text, read for wording such as non-commercial, research only, no derivatives, no redistribution, share alike, attribution required and no model training, the stated terms for commercial use, redistribution and derived works (each allowed, prohibited, restricted or not known), whether it asks for attribution or the same terms downstream, and any other restrictions as stated; the use with its purpose and whether it is commercial, redistributes the data, makes derived works, trains models, plans attribution and releases derived work under the same terms; and each upstream source inside the dataset with its id, name, license and stated terms. The signed report gives the license as recognized with the wording found, every term the use needs as allowed, conflicts, conditional, met, unmet, unread or not_needed with whether it came from the stated term, the SPDX license or the wording, every upstream source as clear, conflicts or unread, and counts them, and names a conflict: a commercial use, redistribution, derived work or model training the license prohibits, share-alike or attribution duties the use does not plan and an upstream source whose terms rule the use out; then commercial use the license allows only under conditions and stated terms that contradict the named license or its text, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An unidentified license and a term the use needs that neither the license nor a source settles leave the rights unverified. This reads one dataset’s terms against one use: the license family a text matches is wever_license-evidence-check and the purposes a consent grant covers are wever_consent-purpose-check. Verdict dataset_license_conflicts, dataset_license_partial, dataset_license_unverified or dataset_license_clear. POST /api/dataset-license-check. Reads the dataset records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Datasets reads a dataset’s own records and checks what is claimed about it: its quality claims against its own sample and profile, its current schema against the documented or prior one, its license against the intended use, its synthetic-data disclosure against its provenance, its freshness against its update log, its lineage against its source records, its privacy claims against its contents and handling, and its coverage against the population it is said to represent. Beside it, wever_data-evidence-check inspects one JSON sample field by field and wever_evaluation-dataset-check reads an evaluation set against what an agent must handle, while a dataset check reads a claim made about a dataset against the dataset’s own records; wever_license-evidence-check names the license family a text matches, while the license check reads the terms against one intended use; and wever_privacy-evidence-check reads privacy claims against a policy document, while the privacy check reads the dataset’s contents and handling records. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-datasets-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-datasets/.
